title: lem-pc-canonical-module-base-change-open-comparison-compat
statement: Choose the shared derived categories and additive tensor pullbacks [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $f:X\to S$, $g:S'\to S$, $g':X'\to X$ and $f':X'\to S'$ be scheme morphisms forming a cartesian square [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $G$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-module and $c:Lg'^*(G[0])\to(g'^*G)[0]$ satisfy IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison [def-pc-derived-module-base-change-map]. For arbitrary opens $V\subseteq S$, $W\subseteq S'$ with $W\subseteq g^{-1}V$, set $U=f^{-1}V$, $f_V=f|_V:U\to V$, $g_V=g|_W:W\to V$, $H=G|_U$, $P=U\times_V W$, $p:P\to U$, and $q:P\to W$. Let $R:D(S')\to D(W)$ be the exact derived restriction [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. There exist $c_V:Lp^*(H[0])\to(p^*H)[0]$ satisfying IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison, isomorphisms $a:R(Lg^*Rf_*(G[0]))\cong Lg_V^*Rf_{V,*}(H[0])$ and $b:R(Rf'_*(g'^*G)[0])\cong Rq_*((p^*H)[0])$, for which $R(\beta\mathbin{\gg}Rf'_*(c))\mathbin{\gg}b=a\mathbin{\gg}(\beta_V\mathbin{\gg}Rq_*(c_V))$, where $\beta$ and $\beta_V$ are the canonical derived mates of the original and chosen restricted pullback squares [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. No affineness, flatness or quasi-coherence is assumed.

proof.text: Construct the fixed single-module counit components by cancelling the adjunction-preserving tensor-to-ordinary comparison from canonicalSinglePullbackMap. They satisfy IsDerivedModulePullbackComparison directly: use the chosen derived counit and cancel the single embedding of t followed by its inverse.

Apply modulePullbackComparison_target_automorphism twice: c=c_fixed followed by alpha[0] and c0=c0_fixed followed by gamma[0]. Obtain a,b for the fixed components from lem-pc-base-change-open-fixed-counits. Let A be restriction of Rf'_* applied to alpha[0] and B be Rq_* applied to gamma[0]. Replace b by A inverse followed by b followed by B. Functoriality and associativity cancel A followed by A inverse; compose the fixed equality with B to obtain the required equality for the two supplied comparisons.

proof_origin.place: Fixed-counit restriction reduced separately; independence of the two supplied comparisons via the existing target-automorphism theorem, with the conjugation calculation proved in Lean.
